bottleneck.description: World leader in machine-tool touch probes, CMM probes, optical/wireless transmission probes, and laser/encoder calibration; effective duopoly with Hexagon plus specialized peers (Heidenhain, Zeiss, Blum, Marposs).

dependency.key_customers: Boeing, Lockheed Martin (F-35), Ford, GM (EV battery), aerospace/auto Tier-1s, medical device manufacturers, semicap and machine-tool OEMs
dependency.key_suppliers: Optics/laser component suppliers, ASIC/electronics suppliers, precision-machining sub-suppliers, ruby/sapphire stylus material vendors

editorial.notes: Renishaw is the industry standard for workpiece and tool probes on CNC machine tools, with deep CAM/CNC ecosystem integration (Boeing, Lockheed, Ford, GM, F-35) and a strong installed base in metrology. The probe/encoder market is moderately consolidated with Hexagon as the principal direct rival, plus Heidenhain (CNC-integrated probes), Zeiss (scanning/CMM), Blum-Novotest, and Marposs. Switching cost is meaningful (post-process inspection workflows, programming integration, brand reliability) but not prohibitive, and aerospace/auto buyers actively dual-source. The competitive structure (handful of qualified suppliers, real switching friction) is closest to the MEDIUM band rather than LOW or HIGH.
